headline: AAP Launches 'Mhargai Mukti Yatra' in Goa
summary: The Aam Aadmi Party has launched a state-wide campaign called 'Mhargai Mukti Yatra' in Goa to raise awareness about inflation. The party promises welfare benefits worth Rs 15,000 per family to relieve financial pressure.

headline: AAP Leader Atishi Highlights Rising Inflation in Goa
summary: Aam Aadmi Party leader Atishi criticized rising living costs in Goa, stating that inflation has made basic items like breakfast expensive. She emphasized the financial burden being faced by ordinary households in the state.

headline: AAP Starts Campaign Against Inflation and Corruption in Goa
summary: AAP has initiated a statewide campaign across Goa targeting inflation, political defections, and governance corruption. The party aims to mobilize public support through rallies and outreach efforts.

headline: Academy Official at IFFI Discusses High Oscar Fees
summary: Speaking at the International Film Festival of India in Goa, an Academy official noted that campaign costs for the Oscars can be prohibitive for filmmakers. The discussion highlighted financial hurdles faced by foreign submissions.

headline: 57th IFFI Reflects National Political Climate in Goa
summary: The 57th International Film Festival of India showcased cinema that mirrors contemporary Indian political and social developments. Beyond Goa's relaxed atmosphere, the festival brought key societal discussions to the screen.

headline: Film 'Skylark' Premieres at IFFI Focusing on Border Divisions
summary: The film 'Skylark' was showcased at IFFI in Goa, capturing the human and emotional toll of divided borders. The screening emphasized personal narratives impacted by geopolitical boundaries.

headline: Second Volume of 'Churches of Goa' Released
summary: The Auxiliary Bishop officially released the second volume of the book 'Churches of Goa'. The publication documents the historical and architectural heritage of Christian places of worship across the state.

headline: Spain Nears Co-Production Pact with India at IFFI Goa
summary: Spain concluded its run as the Country of Honor at IFFI Goa and WAVES Film Bazaar by advancing a new bilateral film co-production agreement with India. The deal aims to enhance creative collaboration between the two countries.

headline: Goa Anticipates Slower Winter Tourist Season
summary: Goa's popular beach destinations may experience lower tourist footfall this winter season. Local hospitality and tourism sectors are preparing for a potential drop in domestic and international arrivals.

headline: Royal Enfield Flying Flea C6 Expands to Goa
summary: Royal Enfield has officially launched its Flying Flea C6 model in the Goa market. Sales and distribution arrangements are now established across regional dealerships.

headline: British Tourist Shares Emotional Farewell After Vacation in Goa
summary: A British visitor expressed deep emotion as her week-long holiday in Goa came to an end. She lauded the state's hospitality and scenic beauty prior to her departure.

headline: Goa Featured Among Top Indian Destinations for Christmas
summary: A travel roundup has named Goa alongside Shillong as one of the top eight locations in India to celebrate Christmas. The state is noted for its holiday festivities, historic churches, and vibrant local celebrations.

headline: Flight Fare Trends Detailed for December Travel to Goa
summary: Air travel data reveals the most affordable and expensive dates to fly into Goa during December from major hubs like Delhi, Mumbai, and Bengaluru. Travelers are encouraged to book early to manage peak season pricing.

headline: Bisleri Clarifies FSSAI Scrutiny Limited to Single Goa Batch
summary: Bisleri confirmed that FSSAI safety scrutiny applied only to a single batch produced in Goa, which has since been removed from circulation. The company assured customers that all products currently on sale meet quality standards.

headline: AAP Unveils Six Welfare Guarantees Against Inflation in Goa
summary: The Aam Aadmi Party has proposed six welfare guarantees to Goan citizens to combat high living costs. The campaign pitch promises financial assistance and cost relief for local households.

headline: ABVP Secures Major Victory in Goa University Elections
summary: The Akhil Bharatiya Vidyarthi Parishad achieved a sweeping victory in the Goa University student council elections. The organization secured key positions, dominating campus student representation.

headline: Historic 1962 Writing Cited in Modern Goa Land Debates
summary: A religious tract from 1962 has re-entered political discussions regarding land rights and activism in Goa. The historical document connects long-standing local debates with current political arguments.

headline: Sales Begin for Flying Flea C6 in Goa
summary: Retail sales for the Royal Enfield Flying Flea C6 electric motorcycle have officially commenced in Goa. Dealerships are offering booking and product details to local customers.

headline: ABVP Wins All Nine Seats in Goa University Council Polls
summary: ABVP won all nine seats in the Goa University Student Council elections, leaving the rival NSUI without a single victory. The total win cements ABVP's control over university student governance.

headline: ABVP Sweeps Goa University Student Council Elections
summary: ABVP candidates swept all nine contested positions in the Goa University Students' Council polls. The election results mark a complete victory for the student organization on campus.

headline: Goa Resident Defrauded of Rs 2.4 Lakh for Mobile Home
summary: A Goa resident recovering from surgery was cheated of Rs 2.4 lakh while trying to buy a mobile home for his caregivers. The victim filed a complaint after the seller failed to deliver the accommodation.

headline: NCC Cadets Launch 220-km Maritime Expedition Along Goa Coast
summary: NCC cadets have begun a 220-kilometer maritime sailing expedition along the Karwar-Goa coastline. The exercise aims to develop nautical skills and physical endurance among participating youth.

headline: Centre Defends Goa ST Quota Law in High Court
summary: The Central Government informed the High Court that Goa's Scheduled Tribe quota law adheres strictly to constitutional mandates. The filing affirmed the legal validity of the state's reservation framework.

headline: GHRDC Launches Housing Loan Scheme for Employees
summary: The Goa Human Resource Development Corporation has introduced a house-building loan scheme for its workforce. The initiative provides affordable credit options to help staff purchase or build residential properties.

headline: High Spring Tide Inundates Parts of Mala
summary: Low-lying areas in Mala experienced waterlogging following an unusually high spring tide that pushed seawater inland. Authorities monitored the temporary flooding caused by the rising water levels.

headline: Porvorim Flyover Entry and Exit Ramps to Open Soon
summary: All access ramps for the Porvorim flyover will be fully open to traffic within two weeks. The opening of the entry and exit points is expected to ease highway traffic flow.

headline: Salcete Farmers Concern Over New Auction Rules for Khazans
summary: Tenant farmers in Salcete warned that new auction guidelines could jeopardize the traditional khazan farming system. They urged officials to safeguard community-managed coastal agricultural lands.

headline: MLA Reginaldo Meets Amit Shah Over Detained Goans
summary: MLA Reginaldo Lourenco met Union Home Minister Amit Shah to seek central support for Goans detained abroad. He urged fast diplomatic intervention to help return affected citizens.

headline: Goa Updates Building Rules for Higher FAR and 40-Metre Structures
summary: Goa has revised its planning rules to allow a Floor Area Ratio of up to 300 and building heights up to 40 meters. The updated regulation also offers a framework to regularize previously sanctioned FAR.

headline: Unsafe Vasco Building Slated for Demolition
summary: Local authorities in Vasco have ordered the demolition of a hazardous structure to ensure public safety. The site will be cleared to allow for modern reconstruction.

headline: Congress Warns of Non-Resident Voter Influx in Goa
summary: The Goa Congress unit alerted electoral officers regarding an influx of non-resident voters onto local electoral rolls. Party leadership demanded strict verification measures to prevent illegal voter additions.

headline: Central Help Sought for Goans Detained in US
summary: MLA Reginaldo has appealed to the Central Government to facilitate the safe return of Goans currently held in US detention centers. He urged federal diplomatic channels to assist the affected individuals.

headline: British Couple Shares Emotional Farewell to Goa
summary: A visiting British couple expressed sadness upon concluding their holiday, describing Goa as a special destination. They voiced appreciation for the region's scenic beauty and local hospitality.

headline: Supreme Court Refuses Stay on Goa ST Quota Ruling
summary: The Supreme Court declined to grant an interim stay on an order regarding Scheduled Tribe seat reservation in the Goa Legislative Assembly. Judicial proceedings on the petition will continue.

headline: Black Friday Sales Gain Traction in Goa
summary: Shoppers across Goa turned out in large numbers to take advantage of Black Friday discounts offered by retailers. Stores and online platforms reported steady consumer interest across categories.

headline: Goan Prelate Resigns as Bishop of Daltonganj
summary: A Goan prelate has formally submitted his resignation from the position of Bishop of Daltonganj. The resignation was accepted under canonical guidelines.

headline: Tripurari Pournima Celebrated with Sangodotsav in Veling
summary: Devotees in Veling observed Tripurari Pournima with the traditional boat festival known as Sangodotsav. The cultural event featured decorated watercraft processions along the river.

headline: Kerala Native Arrested for Laptop and Scooter Theft in Goa
summary: Goa Police apprehended a native of Kerala for stealing a laptop and a two-wheeler. Law enforcement successfully recovered the stolen items during their investigation.

headline: Goa's Historic Riverfront Heritage Highlighted
summary: A feature story examines the architectural and cultural significance of Goa's historic riverfront structures. The piece emphasizes the importance of preserving iconic waterfront monuments.

headline: Taj Fort Aguada Adopts Solar Power Project
summary: Indian Hotels Company Limited has commissioned a new solar power installation at Taj Fort Aguada in Goa. The green energy project aims to advance sustainable operations across the property.

headline: Priol Delegation Questions Proposed ST Reservation
summary: A delegation from Priol submitted a memorandum questioning the plan to designate political ST reservation in their constituency. They requested a review of local demographic data before implementing changes.

headline: South Goa Earns 'Saksham District' Status for HIV Control
summary: South Goa was recognized as a 'Saksham District' for successfully meeting key targets in national HIV prevention programs. Health officials commended local medical teams for their effective public health measures.

headline: AAP Launches Statewide 'Mhargai Mukti Yatra'
summary: The Aam Aadmi Party has begun its statewide 'Mhargai Mukti Yatra' in Goa to demand government action against high inflation. The campaign will feature public outreach programs in every region.

headline: Bicholim River Desilting Cleared to Prevent Flooding
summary: The Goa Coastal Zone Management Authority approved a 2.8-kilometer desilting project along the Bicholim River. The clearing work is designed to improve river drainage and minimize flood risks.

headline: Traffic Diversions Set for Dona Paula-Bambolim Road
summary: Traffic restrictions will be enforced on the Dona Paula-Bambolim road on November 28 and 29. The diversions are scheduled to facilitate physical fitness tests for SSC candidates.

headline: 42 Decorated Boats Light Up Tripurari Pournima in Sanquelim
summary: Sanquelim celebrated Tripurari Pournima with a competition featuring 42 brightly lit, handcrafted boats. Thousands of visitors gathered along the riverbank to view the annual spectacle.

headline: Calangute Opens Temporary Parking for Peak Season
summary: To address anticipated traffic congestion during the peak tourist season, local authorities designated a temporary parking zone in Calangute. The arrangement aims to keep coastal transit routes clear.

headline: Margao Western Bypass Link Opened After Delay
summary: The long-delayed final section of the Margao Western Bypass has been completed and opened to vehicular traffic. The link is expected to significantly reduce congestion within Margao city limits.

headline: Former CM Laxmikant Parsekar Rejoins BJP in Goa
summary: Former Goa Chief Minister Laxmikant Parsekar has officially rejoined the Bharatiya Janata Party. Political observers view his return as an important factor ahead of upcoming regional alliances.

headline: Court Grants Bail to Suspect in 3.7 kg Ganja Seizure
summary: A court in Goa has granted bail to a man arrested for possessing 3.7 kilograms of ganja. The judge placed specific compliance conditions on the accused following the ruling.
